signals.title: Codex closes turn admission during graceful shutdown before waiting for admitted work to drain
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Graceful Shutdown 时先关闭 Turn Admission，再等待已准入工作排空
signals.summary: Codex now closes a shared admission gate when app-server shutdown begins, rejects new turn and thread lifecycle work including automatic queued and goal continuations, rechecks serialized turn requests before execution, and waits for already admitted requests plus running turns to drain while keeping reads and turn interruption available.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在在 App-server 开始关停时先关闭共享准入门，拒绝新的 Turn 与 Thread Lifecycle 工作，包括自动 Queue/Goal Continuation，并在序列化请求真正执行前再次检查准入；同时等待已准入请求与 Running Turn 排空，但仍保留读取和 Turn Interrupt。

researchValue.failure: A server can appear to be draining while queued, serialized or automatic continuations continue creating new state-changing work, preventing a clean lifecycle boundary.
researchValue.mechanism: Close admission before drain, track admitted-but-not-yet-running work, recheck delayed requests at execution time, and keep only observability/interruption paths open during drain.
researchValue.implication: A long-running digital employee should model shutdown as an authority transition: stop granting new work first, then drain already authorized work, rather than equating zero currently running turns with safe termination.

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK prevents UnixLocal sandbox path authorization from being bypassed by symlink races
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 防止 UnixLocal Sandbox 的路径授权被符号链接竞态绕过
signals.summary: The UnixLocal sandbox file API moved to descriptor-relative traversal with O_NOFOLLOW, pinned canonical roots, path reauthorization, and an isolated trusted file worker for user-scoped operations so a workspace process cannot swap symlinks between path validation and host file access.
signals.summary_zh: UnixLocal Sandbox 文件 API 改为基于目录文件描述符的遍历并使用 O_NOFOLLOW，同时固定 Canonical Root、再次校验路径，并将 User-scoped 操作放入隔离的可信文件 Worker，防止 Workspace 进程在路径校验与 Host 文件访问之间替换符号链接。

researchValue.failure: Authorizing a pathname and then opening it later can be unsafe when an untrusted workspace can replace path components with symlinks between the two operations.
researchValue.mechanism: Pin authorized roots, traverse with directory descriptors and no-follow flags, and perform the actual file operation relative to the already-authorized directory chain.
researchValue.implication: Sandbox authorization should bind the filesystem object reached at execution time, not merely a string path that was valid earlier.

signals.title: Google ADK nested-workflow retries replay only children that left durable output or state evidence
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 的嵌套 Workflow 重试只会重放留下持久 Output 或 State 证据的已完成子节点
signals.summary: Google ADK made a child failure count as a Workflow failure for retry policy. When the sub-workflow retries, children that already emitted output or state changes are replayed from session events, while a child that emitted neither has no completion evidence and runs again; retry attempt counters also do not survive interrupt/resume.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 将子节点失败正式视为 Workflow 失败并进入 Retry Policy。子 Workflow 重试时，已产生 Output 或 State Change 的子节点会从 Session Events 重放；没有留下两者的子节点缺少完成证据，会再次执行；Retry Attempt Counter 也不会跨 Interrupt/Resume 持久化。

researchValue.failure: A side-effecting node can be executed twice after workflow retry when it leaves no durable output or state record proving that it already completed.
researchValue.mechanism: Use durable event evidence to replay completed children and rerun only nodes whose completion cannot be reconstructed, while treating retry budgets separately from persisted workflow state.
researchValue.implication: Recovery safety depends on what the runtime can prove about prior execution; a successful external effect without durable local completion evidence remains duplicate-risk work.

signals.title: TROVE treats an agent route as provisional and replaces only the suffix invalidated by runtime evidence
signals.title_zh: TROVE 将 Agent Route 视为暂定计划，只替换被运行证据否定的后缀
signals.summary: TROVE distills evaluated workflow traces into skills and an outcome-conditioned transition graph, then treats a planned route as provisional online: after observing runtime evidence it keeps a valid continuation, inserts a local trace-supported response, or replaces only the invalid suffix instead of executing stale steps or replanning the whole route.
signals.summary_zh: TROVE 将已评估 Workflow Trace 蒸馏为 Skills 与 Outcome-conditioned Transition Graph，并在运行时把计划 Route 视为暂定：获得新证据后保留仍有效的 Continuation、插入局部 Trace-supported Response，或只替换失效后缀，而不是继续执行过期步骤或整条重规划。

researchValue.failure: Precommitted execution plans become stale when intermediate outcomes change what should happen next, while full replanning can discard valid progress and add cost.
researchValue.finding: Across code generation, QA and math reasoning benchmarks, the reported gains are largest when observed outcomes change the appropriate continuation, and suffix replacement mainly improves efficiency.
researchValue.mechanism: Condition route continuation on evaluated runtime traces and edit only the portion invalidated by new evidence.
researchValue.implication: Agent runtimes can separate durable completed work from still-provisional future work, revising the smallest unproved suffix instead of restarting a whole process.

signals.title: TruthInsightBench finds scientific-agent bottlenecks in controls, robustness and falsifiability rather than basic execution
signals.title_zh: TruthInsightBench 发现科学 Agent 的主要瓶颈在控制、稳健性与可证伪性，而不是基础执行
signals.summary: TruthInsightBench evaluates 40 blind discovery tasks from 40 peer-reviewed studies across ten domains while hiding source conclusions, expected values and analysis paths. Four coding agents on one frozen base model cluster around 58.4–60.3/100: execution and documentation are comparatively competent, but controls, robustness, falsifiability and cross-dataset generalization remain weak.
signals.summary_zh: TruthInsightBench 从 40 项同行评审研究构造 40 个跨 10 个领域的 Blind Discovery Task，并隐藏原论文结论、期望数值和分析路径。在同一 Frozen Base Model 上，4 个 Coding Agent 集中在 58.4–60.3/100；执行与文档相对成熟，但控制、稳健性、可证伪性与跨数据集泛化仍明显薄弱。

researchValue.failure: A benchmark can overstate agent research capability when it rewards reproducing a hidden target result rather than independently deciding what claim the evidence supports.
researchValue.finding: The evaluated agents formed a narrow score plateau with no reliable pairwise separation and were strongest at execution/documentation but weak at the discriminating acts needed for trustworthy claims.
researchValue.mechanism: Hide target conclusions and analysis paths, then score the agent's own claims against artifact-grounded dimensions with deterministic aggregation.
researchValue.implication: Evaluating autonomous knowledge workers should distinguish task completion from evidentiary judgment, especially controls, robustness, falsifiability and generalization.

signals.title: EDGE admits multi-step tool-composition links only after they succeed against live public APIs
signals.title_zh: EDGE 只在真实公共 API 调用成功后才接纳多步工具组合边
signals.summary: KOPA-Bench contributes 145 real multi-step tasks over Korean public APIs. Its EDGE synthesis method builds candidate output-to-input tool links but retains only links that actually succeed against live APIs, then traverses those verified links to create executable trajectories; a trained 9B model nearly matches an untuned 27B model and improves on BFCL as well.
signals.summary_zh: KOPA-Bench 包含 145 个基于韩国公共 API 的真实多步任务。其 EDGE 方法先构建 Output-to-input 工具候选边，但只保留在真实 API 调用中成功的连接，再遍历这些已验证边生成可执行轨迹；训练后的 9B 模型接近同系列未调优 27B 模型，并在 BFCL 上同步提升。

researchValue.failure: Schema-compatible tool outputs and inputs do not prove that a composed edge is operationally executable against live systems.
researchValue.finding: The study reports that training on trajectories built from live-validated edges materially improves a 9B model and transfers gains to BFCL.
researchValue.mechanism: Admit tool-composition edges only after real execution succeeds, then synthesize trajectories over the verified graph.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee tool graphs should distinguish structurally possible connections from execution-proven connections and treat the latter as stronger operational evidence.
